limitations: Prototype-level evidence only. The listed requirement IDs are context, not evidence that any requirement is met.

Windows x64: built (zig/mingw, UCRT) and cargo-checked only. Named pipe, console Ctrl-C, CreateProcess quoting and console resize are compile-checked only. Native run blocked: needs a Windows 10/11 x64 host.
linux-x64 runs are emulated (Docker Desktop amd64 emulation on an arm64 host), not native x86-64.
The darwin 'no toolchain' check used env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin on the build machine itself, not a clean macOS machine.
Linux runs are containers on Docker Desktop's Linux VM; WSL not tested.

K6 states tested: no controlling terminal (cargo test on macOS and in containers), foreground job, background job. Not tested: an explicit signal sent while heimdall-proto is itself stopped after Ctrl-Z (the signal stays pending until SIGCONT).
Known gap, outside K6's explicit-signal rule: in background-job mode a signal sent to the whole process group reaches the child twice.
K3: a connection reset (not EOF) after at least one byte is still reported AGENT_UNAVAILABLE, as before; K3 rules only on EOF there.

Toolchain drift: rustup stable moved from rustc 1.98.1 to 1.99.0 between attempts, so attempt-2 digests differ from attempt 1 for reasons beyond the code changes. The crate has no rust-toolchain.toml pin.
The shared harness was run read-only for information only; its verdict was not used (harness in flux, and it hit harness-side pyte IndexError and pty deadlock again).
The windows-x64 digest was not bit-reproducible between identical builds in attempt 1; not re-checked in attempt 2.
